reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Scaling up of interventions to combat tuberculosis in Côte d'Ivoire - Côte d'Ivoire (01-Jan-2021-31-Dec-2023)

description.narrative: Côte d'Ivoire, Tuberculosis, Ministry of Health, Public Hygiene and Universal Health Coverage of the Republic of Côte d’Ivoire (MOH - PNLT)This program has the following goals: Réduire le nombre de décès lié à la tuberculose de 60 % à l’horizon 2025 par rapport à l’année 2015 / Reduce the number of deaths from tuberculosis by 60% by 2025 compared to the year 2015.. Réduire l’incidence de la tuberculose de 50% à l’horizon 2025 par rapport à l’année 2015 / Reduce the incidence of tuberculosis by 50% by the year 2025 compared to the year 2015.. The objectives of this program are: Accroître la notification des nouveaux cas et rechutes de tuberculose toutes formes de 21 034 en 2018 à 25 754 en 2023 / Increase the notification of new cases and relapses of all forms of tuberculosis from 21,034 in 2018 to 25,754 in 2023.. Atteindre 90% de taux de succès thérapeutique chez les nouveaux cas et rechutes de tuberculose toutes formes d’ici 2023 / Achieve 90% treatment success rate in new and relapsed cases of all forms of tuberculosis by 2023.. Atteindre 84% de taux de succès thérapeutique chez les malades multi-résistants mis sous traitement de 2ème ligne d’ici 2023 / Achieve 84% treatment success rate in multi-drug resistant patients put on 2nd line therapy by 2023. Renforcer les capacités de gestion et de coordination du programme à tous les niveaux / Strengthen programme management and coordination capacities at all levels

title.narrative: Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for CIV-T-MOHP05
Percentage of people living with HIV newly initiated on ART who were screened for TB
Number of TB cases (all forms) notified among prisoners
Number of notified cases of all forms of TB (i.e. bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed), new and relapse cases
Number of cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB that began second-line treatment
Percentage of PLHIV on ART who initiated TB preventive therapy among those eligible during the reporting period
Percentage of new and relapse TB patients tested using WHO recommended rapid tests at the time of diagnosis
Percentage of TB patients with DST result for at least Rifampicin among the total number of notified (new and retreatment) cases in the same year
Number of TB cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB notified
Number of people in contact with TB patients who began preventive therapy

Treatment success rate- all forms: Percentage of TB cases, all forms, bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, successfully treated (cured plus treatment completed) among all TB cases registered for treatment during a specified period, new and relapse cases

Percentage of laboratories showing adequate performance in external quality assurance for smear microscopy among the total number of laboratories that undertake smear microscopy during the reporting period
Percentage of HIV-positive new and relapse TB patients on ART during TB treatment
Percentage of registered new and relapse TB patients with documented HIV status
Outcome indicators targets and results for CIV-T-MOHP05
Treatment success rate of all forms of TB - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, new and relapse
Notification of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB cases – Percentage of notified cases of bacteriologically confirmed, drug resistant RR-TB and/or MDR-TB as a proportion of all estimated RR-TB and/or MDR-TB cases

TB treatment coverage: Percentage of patients with new and relapse TB that were notified and treated among the estimated number of incident TB in the same year (all forms of TB - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed
Case notification rate of all forms of TB per 100,000 population - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, new and relapse cases
Treatment success rate of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB: Percentage of patients with RR and/or MDR-TB successfully treated
Impact indicators targets and results for CIV-T-MOHP05
TB incidence rate per 100,000 population
TB mortality rate per 100,000 population
RR-TB and/or MDR-TB prevalence among new TB patients: Proportion of new TB patients with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB
